info.title: Govener Resident and Manager API
info.description: Frontend-driven contract implemented by the Spring Boot backend in backend/. See BACKEND-HANDOFF.md for open product decisions and exact integration boundaries. Amounts are integer TRY minor units (kuruş); dates are ISO calendar dates, timestamps UTC instants, and community time zone is Europe/Istanbul. Localized UI labels never act as IDs or enum values.
